34: def sendEmail(sydent, templateName, mailTo, substitutions):

37: 
38:         myHostname = os.uname()[1]
39:         midRandom = "".join([random.choice(string.ascii_letters) for _ in range(16)])

41:

43:         allSubstitutions.update(substitutions)
44:         allSubstitutions.update({
45:             'messageid': messageid,
46:             'date': email.utils.formatdate(localtime=False),
47:             'to': mailTo,
48:             'from': mailFrom,
49:         })
50: 
51:         for k,v in allSubstitutions.items():
52:             allSubstitutions[k] = v.decode('utf8')
53:             allSubstitutions[k+"_forhtml"] = cgi.escape(v.decode('utf8'))
54:             allSubstitutions[k+"_forurl"] = urllib.quote(v)
55: 
56:         mailString = open(mailTemplateFile).read() % allSubstitutions
57:         rawFrom = email.utils.parseaddr(mailFrom)[1]
58:         rawTo = email.utils.parseaddr(mailTo)[1]
59:         if rawFrom == '' or rawTo == '':
60:             logger.info("Couldn't parse from / to address %s / %s", mailFrom, mailTo)
61:             raise EmailAddressException()
62:         mailServer = sydent.cfg.get('email', 'email.smtphost')
63:         logger.info("Sending mail to %s with mail server: %s" % (mailTo, mailServer,))
64:         try:
65:             smtp = smtplib.SMTP(mailServer)
66:             smtp.sendmail(rawFrom, rawTo, mailString.encode('utf-8'))
67:             smtp.quit()
68:         except Exception as origException:
69:             twisted.python.log.err()
70:             ese = EmailSendException()
71:             ese.cause = origException
72:             raise ese
73:

76:     pass
